title: snMultiome-seq for Projection-TAGs
author: Lite Yang
materials: Gather samples and store them on dry ice.
Prepare buffers and store them on ice. Note: PBS, NIM, and Diluent can be prepared in advance and stored at 4C for up to 3 months. Filter NIM with 0.2 um filter.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Workspace
steps.instruction: Clean and prepare the workspace and tools for nuclear extraction.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the working area clean with 70% ethanol and RNase Zap.
Clean douncers with 70% ethanol and rinse with nuclease-free water 2X; place in clean 50 ml conical tubes and cover with Kimwipe.
Place SW28 rotor into the ultracentrifuge and pre-chill the bench-top centrifuge to 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Iodixanol Gradient
steps.instruction: Create a density gradient in an ultracentrifuge tube and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Layer 1 ml of 40% iodixanol at the bottom of the tube.
Slowly add 1 ml of 30% iodixanol on top, pipetting against the wall to maintain two distinct layers.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Thaw tissue and mechanically disrupt cells to release nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Thaw one sample from dry ice on wet ice for 1 min.
Quick spin to collect tissue at the bottom of the tube.
Add 1 ml of Homogenization Buffer and 10 µl of 10% NP40.
Transfer samples and buffer to a pre-chilled douncer using a P1000 pipette.
Perform 15 strokes with the loose pestle ('A'), followed by 15 strokes with the tight pestle ('B').
Optional: If big chunks remain, let the douncer sit on ice for 1 min, then perform 5 additional strokes with the tight pestle ('B'), rotating the pestle back and forth at the end of each stroke.

steps.title: Nuclear Resuspension and Filtration
steps.instruction: Prepare the homogenate for density gradient centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml of freshly-vortexed 50% iodixanol to the homogenate to achieve a 25% iodixanol concentration.
Bring the sample volume up to 1 ml using Resuspension Buffer.
Invert sample tubes 10X to mix.
Filter the homogenate through a 50 µm Sysmex filter into a 2 ml centrifuge tube (apply positive pressure with thumb if debris is abundant).

steps.title: Density Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Isolate nuclei using the iodixanol gradient.

substeps.instruction: Slowly pipette 2 ml of nuclear resuspensions on top of the 30% layer in the ultracentrifuge tube, pipetting against the wall to maintain distinct layers.
Adjust sample volumes with nuclease-free water to match levels.
Centrifuge at 10,000 g (8,900 rpm with SW28 rotor) for 18 min at 4°C.
Remove 1.5 ml of the 25% iodixanol layer and aspirate surface buffer to remove cell debris.

steps.title: Interlayer Nuclei Collection
steps.instruction: Recover the nuclei from the iodixanol interface.

substeps.instruction: Stab a P200 pipette tip to the interface of 30% and 40% iodixanol; aspirate 200 µl of the interlayer and transfer to a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube.
Repeat the aspiration 3 times total to collect 600 µl from the interlayer.

steps.title: Nuclei Washing and Recovery
steps.instruction: Wash the collected nuclei to remove iodixanol.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the collected iodixanol with 600 µl of Resuspension Buffer and 6 µl of 7-AAD ready-made solution (5 ng/µl final concentration); pipette mix 10X.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Invert the tube and aspirate the supernatant, leaving ~50 µl to avoid disturbing the pellet.
Centrifuge again at 500 g for 5 min at 4°C to spin down excessive supernatant.
Carefully remove supernatant, leaving ~10 µl.
Resuspend the pellets in up to 500 µl of Resuspension Buffer and pipette mix 10X.

steps.title: FACS Enrichment
steps.instruction: Use Fluorescence-Activated Cell Sorting to enrich for labeled nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Load 10 µl on a hemocytometer and inspect with an epifluorescence microscope using a 7-AAD filter.
Transfer nuclear resuspensions to 5 ml FACS tubes.
Prepare collection tubes by adding 100 µl of Resuspension Buffer to 1.5 ml tubes.
Perform FACS using a 100 µm nozzle.
Gate events on size, linearity, doublet, and 7-AAD signal to select single nuclei.
Set a secondary gate on GFP signal to select Projection-TAG+ nuclei.
For Projection-TAG+ samples, collect 7-AAD+ and GFP+ events; for other samples, collect 7-AAD+ and GFP- events (recommended ≥100k events to target 10k cell recovery).

steps.title: Library Preparation and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare and sequence the snMultiome-seq library.

substeps.instruction: Process nuclei and prepare the library following the 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression user manual.
Sequence the snRNA-seq library targeting at least 100k reads/nuclei.
Sequence the snATAC-seq library according to the user manual.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Process sequencing data using a custom reference genome.

substeps.instruction: Fetch Projection-TAG sequences from the provided GitHub repository.
Generate a custom mouse reference genome containing Projection-TAG features via 10X Genomics instructions.
Run cellranger-arc to map sequencing reads to the custom mouse reference genome.
